name: Festivello
author: BragDeal Inc.

sections.description:
Festivello puts your website in holiday mode without touching your theme.

Pick a holiday, switch it on, and your site gets a temporary seasonal look: a colour overlay across the header, body, footer and font, floating icons drifting over the page, an animated background, and an optional banner message above the header. Switch it off and everything returns to your theme’s own styling instantly. Your theme files are never modified.

Nine holidays are included and ready to use:

  • Christmas
  • Halloween
  • Valentine’s Day
  • New Year
  • Easter
  • Thanksgiving
  • Canada Day
  • Fourth of July
  • Black Friday

Every one of them is fully editable. Change the dates, the colours, the icons, the animation and the banner text on any holiday, as often as you like. There is no limit on how many holidays you use across the year, no trial period, and no expiry.

Features

  • Nine preset holidays, all editable
  • Temporary colour overlay for header, body, footer and font
  • Up to five floating icons per holiday, from an emoji library or raster images selected from your Media Library
  • Five background animations: falling snow, floating hearts, falling leaves, confetti, and a fireworks glow
  • Low, medium and high animation intensity
  • Optional banner message pinned above your header
  • Optional automatic scheduling by date range, including ranges that wrap past December 31
  • One holiday runs at a time, so seasons never collide (Festivello Pro can run several at once)
  • Respects prefers-reduced-motion: animations are skipped for visitors who ask for reduced motion

Built to stay fast

Holiday CSS and JavaScript load only while a holiday is actually active. Nothing is enqueued on your site the rest of the year.

Privacy

Festivello does not collect any data, does not phone home, and does not contact any external server. Everything it does happens on your own site.

Festivello Pro

Everything described above is part of this free plugin, with no limits, no quotas and no expiry, and it stays that way.

Festivello Pro is a separate add-on, available from https://licensehub.bragdeal.cloud/wp-festivello/, for people who want more than one holiday running at a time, or holidays of their own beyond the nine built in here. It adds:

  • Several holidays running at the same time, instead of one at a time
  • Unlimited custom holidays of your own
  • Your own name, start date and end date for each one
  • Your own header, body, footer and font colours per holiday
  • Your own Media Library images, or emoji from the library
  • Any of the five background animations, at any intensity
  • Add-on updates and new Pro features delivered through your dashboard
  • Direct email support from the people who build the plugin

It is useful for anniversaries, product launches, sales and seasonal campaigns that are specific to your business. Pro is an add-on: this plugin stays installed and active, and everything you have already set up keeps working exactly as it does now.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open Festivello in the admin menu.
  4. Toggle a holiday on, or click its name to edit its colours, icons, animation and banner.
sections.faq:
Does this change my theme?

No. The holiday look is a temporary overlay rendered on top of your theme. Your theme files are never edited, and disabling holiday mode restores your original styling immediately.

Can more than one holiday run at once?

Not in this plugin. One holiday mode runs at a time, so seasonal styles never overlap: switching a second holiday on turns the first one off. Festivello Pro adds the ability to run several at the same time, combining their floating icons.

Do holidays turn on by themselves?

Only if you ask them to. Automatic scheduling is off by default, so nothing appears on your site until you switch a holiday on with the toggle in the list. If you tick “Turn this holiday on by itself during the dates above” while editing a holiday, it will then start and stop with its own date range. Editing a holiday never puts it live on its own.

Can I use my own icons?

Yes. Each icon slot accepts an emoji from the built-in library or a JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP or AVIF image from your Media Library.

Will the animations bother visitors who are sensitive to motion?

No. Visitors whose system requests reduced motion will not see the animations. The banner and colours still apply.

Where do I get help?

Questions about this plugin are welcome on its WordPress.org support forum, where answers help everyone who reads them. Festivello Pro customers also get direct email support from us.

Does it slow my site down?

The holiday stylesheet and script are only loaded while a holiday is active. Outside of that, the plugin adds nothing to your front end.
sections.changelog:
1.1.6

  • Switching a second holiday on now says so, and explains that Festivello Pro can run several at once.
  • Added “Activate several holidays at once” to what Festivello Pro adds.
  • A dismissible prompt asks for a WordPress.org review after a day of use. It appears on Festivello’s own screen only, and every button settles it for good or for a week.
  • The admin menu icon is now a Christmas hat.

1.1.5

  • Added the Festivello logo: the plugin now has its own artwork in the WordPress.org plugin directory, its own admin menu icon in place of the generic one, and the mark in its settings header.

1.1.4

  • Legacy settings migrated from pre-1.1.2 development builds are now validated with the same routine the settings form uses, so colours, dates and banner text are sanitized rather than copied verbatim.
  • Documented the nonce that protects the settings form for automated security scanning.
  • Added translator comments to every string containing a placeholder.
  • The admin script now depends on the media modal it actually uses instead of jQuery.
  • Corrected the plugin and product website links.

1.1.3

  • Made checkbox and icon-array request sanitization explicit for WordPress.org automated security scanning.
  • No public API changes; fully compatible with the Festivello 1.1.2 API.

1.1.2

  • Replaced the short WPF public prefix with the unique Festivello prefix across PHP APIs, hooks, options, scripts and styles.
  • Tightened admin request handling so only expected form fields are read and sanitized.
  • Media icons now store validated Media Library attachment references instead of arbitrary image URLs.
  • Raster image validation rejects remote URLs and SVG payloads.
  • Filtered banner output now passes through a strict wp_kses() allowlist.
  • Updated the Pro extension points to the new Festivello API names.
  • Added a safe one-time migration for settings created by pre-1.1.2 development builds.

1.1.1

  • Updated the plugin name and slug for WordPress.org directory compliance.
  • Improved admin request validation and input sanitization.

1.1.0

  • The plugin header now shows which edition is running.
  • Removed the Performance tab: it only restated behaviour that is always on.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
